authorization.scope: User explicitly authorizes ongoing Jev validation API use without per-run approval questions
authorization.retryRule: No outcome-driven request replay. A second bounded run may verify an identified infrastructure repair or check repeatability, keeping all outcomes.

invariants: No participant actions or feedback in model inputs
Same full viewport image-only observation and memory3
Same goal policy and argmax selection
No forced alternative, banned revisit or automatic done rewrite

criteria.recoveryOpportunity: A chosen route fails to attain the goal and the model returns to an earlier observed screen before changing its route
criteria.recoveryObserved: After that opportunity, actual actions select another branch and new goal-relevant information is observed; success is measured separately
criteria.directSuccess: A direct correct route without a failed route does not establish recovery
criteria.repeatPath: Report observed exact cycles and selected/effect assessments without declaring a LOOP termination unless triggered
criteria.subjectiveOutcome: Model done/abandon/stuck is distinct from objective notifications oracle
criteria.APIError: Infrastructure failure is not user uncertainty, abandonment or failure to discover UX problems

limits: Single archived baseline; model generation seed is not controllable
More API calls per decision are an explicit policy change
Human unnumbered native rendering differs; this tests current mode capability, not human reproduction
Only model assessment self-reports; no hidden expectation or understanding claim
